preconditions: independent grouping review then freeze split
event/span labels for claimed detector recall/localization
configured provider access and explicit spend budget before paid calls
source_coverage: every source message exactly once in core, overlap previous 2 source messages
context_policy: structured state + event ledger + overlap; complete original re-read by final judge

systems.path: all k chunks sequential extraction + full original judge
TFIDF CPU event candidates, s chunks LLM verification, original full judge, hidden preliminary scores/classes
frozen API embeddings + CPU classifier; same verification/judge
reuse preregistered selected H_hidden candidates and accepted ledger, expose preliminary classes/scores only in final judge input

inner_validation: 3 folds by train topic family if class support permits, otherwise unsupported; every fitted preprocessing component stays inside fold
feature_allowlist: original text in core and prior context
original timestamps/relative positions with documented interpretation
null_policy: missing labels remain unlabelled, never negative
rare_event_policy: unsupported event/language/new criterion -> LLM fallback, never absence inferred from classifier negative
LLM_choice: select analyst/judge on train and freeze identical pair across architectures; Sol/Astra in cost sheet only an assumption
final_value_source: current checklist snapshot allowed_values, NA rule and scales
final_score: existing deterministic calculator, no chunk averaging
primary_metrics: total MAE with paired count and completion
missing_prediction_policy: known GT remains in accuracy denominator; missing is not correct abstention; expose perlabel coverage
unlabelled_reference_policy: exclude only that unknown label with explicit count; not zero or no
total_policy: pairs with valid computable totals; report common-pair comparison and completion, no zero imputation
F1_class_policy: configured classes, publish support; jointly absent/unpredicted classes undefined and omitted with explicit convention
uncertainty: paired bootstrap by family; only 7 test families and one voice, no strong significance claims
anchoring_ablation: same candidates and verified ledger, hidden versus visible untrusted classifier class/score
evidence_order_ablation: train first: separate evidence-first extraction committed before grade vs score-then-explanation, comparable total budget
boundary_ablation: pre-register all 8/12/20; reuse 12 outputs; do not select prompt/budget on test
logging_fields: price version and unknown billed usage
provider_settings: capabilities-specific; no sampling by default; per-stage output caps fixed on train before test
leakage_disclosure: DEV contents and provisional labels already inspected; proposed internal fixed test is not an unseen official set
release_policy: research artifacts only; do not publish raw transcripts, signed audio URLs or tokens
